purpose: A 200-level engineering overlay that converts common frontier-AI marketing claims into falsifiable, implementation-bearing, adversarially tested and comparator-backed obligations.

topology.construction: 20 competitive claim families x 10 engineering escalation stages
topology.scope_rule: overlay only; does not create top-level volumes beyond VOL-420
topology.completion_rule: No level is complete because prose exists. Completion requires exact-head implementation, tests, adversarial evidence and the declared exit criteria.
topology.superiority_rule: ENG-x10 family exits require reproducible Pareto-safe comparator evidence and independent promotion authority.

non_negotiable_laws: marketing language is never implementation evidence
all levels bind to existing canonical volumes and owners; no hidden parallel architecture
models may propose optimizations but deterministic control planes authorize privileged effects
security privacy authority tenancy and acknowledged-state safety are non-compensable
every optimized path keeps a tested reference or rollback path unless an approved exception proves impossibility
benchmarks bind source model policy dataset scorer environment and budget identities
tail saturation recovery and adversarial behavior are part of the product, not optional benchmark dimensions
superiority claims expire when material identities or operating envelopes drift

stages.title: Claim Contract
stages.focus: Translate the boast into a falsifiable comparator contract, workload envelope, target metrics, budgets and non-compensable gates.

stages.title: Architecture Ownership
stages.focus: Assign canonical owners, boundaries, dependency direction, reference path and explicit capability interfaces.

stages.title: Typed Contracts
stages.focus: Define versioned schemas, states, invariants, compatibility rules, trust labels and deterministic serialization.

stages.title: Admission & Control Plane
stages.focus: Add identity, policy, budgets, deadlines, cancellation, authority checks, resource admission and bounded control flow.

stages.title: State & Provenance
stages.focus: Make state ownership durable and reconstructable with lineage, receipts, checkpoints, idempotency and lifecycle semantics.

stages.title: Adversarial Hardening
stages.focus: Exercise abuse, malformed input, uncertainty, concurrency, partial failure and cross-boundary attacks with fail-closed behavior.

stages.title: Performance & Economics
stages.focus: Measure latency, tails, throughput, saturation, resource use and cost under production-like workloads without weakening hard gates.

stages.title: Recovery, Migration & Rollback
stages.focus: Prove restart, replay, compensation, migration compatibility, rollback/reference fallback and disaster recovery.

stages.title: Independent Evaluation
stages.focus: Run reproducible challenger-vs-baseline studies with exact identities, independent scoring, uncertainty and raw evidence.

stages.title: Continuous Superiority
stages.focus: Promote only with exact-head Pareto evidence, then continuously expire, requalify and demote when evidence or operating envelopes drift.

families.title: Reasoning & Deliberation
families.competitor_claim: deeper reasoning, stronger chain-of-thought-like capability, better hard-problem accuracy
families.objective: Deliver bounded multi-strategy reasoning that improves task success without hidden unbounded compute or unverifiable self-claims.
families.baseline: single-pass or opaque deliberation with best-effort self-checking

families.title: Long Context & Context Integrity
families.competitor_claim: massive context windows and reliable use of very long inputs
families.objective: Make long context useful, attributable, policy-safe and degradation-aware rather than merely accepted by a tokenizer.
families.baseline: flat prompt concatenation with truncation or attention dilution

families.title: Memory & Personalization
families.competitor_claim: persistent memory and personalized continuity across sessions
families.objective: Provide scoped, correctable, provenance-bearing memory with deterministic lifecycle and zero cross-boundary leakage.
families.baseline: embedding memory with heuristic writes and weak lifecycle semantics

families.title: Agents & Autonomous Execution
families.competitor_claim: autonomous agents that can work for long periods and finish complex objectives
families.objective: Achieve durable, bounded, recoverable autonomy with explicit authority, checkpoints, handoffs and completion proof.
families.baseline: ephemeral agent loop with heuristic delegation and stopping

families.title: Tools & Computer Use
families.competitor_claim: reliable tool use, browser/computer control and real-world action
families.objective: Turn every tool action into a policy-bound transaction with schema, authorization, idempotency, postconditions and receipts.
families.baseline: model-direct function calling with schema validation

families.title: Coding & Software Engineering
families.competitor_claim: best-in-class coding, repository understanding, debugging and autonomous software delivery
families.objective: Move from patch generation to graph-aware, transaction-safe software engineering with independent verification and provenance.
families.baseline: text search plus patch plus tests

families.title: Retrieval, Search & Research
families.competitor_claim: deep research, web-scale synthesis and superior RAG
families.objective: Produce evidence-linked research through authorization-first retrieval, source quality scoring, contradiction handling and reproducible synthesis.
families.baseline: single-stage vector RAG or search-summary loop

families.title: Multimodal Perception & Generation
families.competitor_claim: native image, audio, video and document understanding/generation
families.objective: Treat every modality as typed evidence with provenance, temporal/spatial alignment, malformed-media bounds and cross-modal verification.
families.baseline: provider-native multimodal prompting with weak provenance

families.title: Realtime Voice, Video & Interaction
families.competitor_claim: natural realtime conversation with low latency and interruption handling
families.objective: Provide sequence-correct, interruptible, resumable realtime interaction with bounded latency and state consistency across modalities.
families.baseline: best-effort streaming session with loose turn ownership

families.title: Math, Science & Formal Verification
families.competitor_claim: expert mathematical/scientific reasoning and trustworthy technical answers
families.objective: Bind mathematical and scientific claims to executable checks, formal tools, units, uncertainty and evidence when applicable.
families.baseline: language-model answer with optional self-check

families.title: Planning & Long-Horizon Task Control
families.competitor_claim: plans that survive long projects, changing constraints and partial failure
families.objective: Compile objectives into validated dependency DAGs with budgets, critical paths, checkpoints, replanning and terminal guarantees.
families.baseline: linear natural-language plan with heuristic replanning

families.title: Routing, Ensembles & Model Orchestration
families.competitor_claim: smart model selection, mixtures of models and automatic fallback
families.objective: Route by capability, quality, privacy, reliability, latency and cost with measured policies and no security downgrade on fallback.
families.baseline: static provider/model fallback

families.title: Learning, Adaptation & Self-Improvement
families.competitor_claim: systems that learn from use, adapt and improve themselves
families.objective: Convert outcomes into gated candidates through sandboxed learning, causal evaluation, rollback and anti-regression controls.
families.baseline: online heuristics or prompt/config updates from recent feedback

families.title: Safety, Alignment & Policy Control
families.competitor_claim: safer models with strong alignment and controllability
families.objective: Move safety from prompt instructions into independent policy, capability admission, risk classification and auditable enforcement.
families.baseline: prompt-level policy plus model refusal behavior

families.title: Security, Privacy & Tenancy
families.competitor_claim: enterprise-safe private AI with secure data handling
families.objective: Enforce zero-trust identity, tenancy, secret isolation, data lifecycle, egress and revocable delegated authority end to end.
families.baseline: application auth plus provider privacy controls

families.title: Reliability, Recovery & Distributed Execution
families.competitor_claim: always-on dependable AI infrastructure
families.objective: Guarantee bounded retries, durable queues, fencing, unknown-outcome handling, checkpoints, load shedding and tested disaster recovery.
families.baseline: horizontal scale with retries and circuit breakers

families.title: Inference Performance & Advanced Serving
families.competitor_claim: faster tokens, lower latency and higher throughput
families.objective: Optimize the full latency/throughput frontier with continuous batching, caching, speculative paths and safe reference fallbacks.
families.baseline: framework-default multi-worker serving

families.title: Scale, Hardware & Resource Efficiency
families.competitor_claim: massive scale, efficient accelerator use and lower cost
families.objective: Make placement topology-aware across CPU/GPU/RAM/VRAM/NUMA/interconnect/network/storage with admission and measurable efficiency.
families.baseline: generic autoscaling and device allocation

families.title: Enterprise Governance & Operations
families.competitor_claim: enterprise readiness, compliance, admin control and production operability
families.objective: Make every critical AI behavior governable through SLOs, audit, change control, rights, deployment, rollback, support and operator controls.
families.baseline: feature-complete AI service plus conventional admin console

families.title: Evaluation, Benchmark Integrity & Proof
families.competitor_claim: state-of-the-art benchmark scores and superior real-world quality
families.objective: Require contamination-aware, reproducible, uncertainty-bearing comparator studies and independent promotion authority for every superiority claim.
families.baseline: aggregate benchmark score or curated demo
